name: Indian On-line Handwriting Recognition Benchmark
description: A public benchmark dataset and evaluation protocol for online handwriting recognition across multiple Indian scripts.
reputation: Widely used within the Indian-script handwriting research community as a standard multi-script online handwriting benchmark, but less known outside that niche.
notes: Evaluated using character/word accuracy and error rates; moderate dataset size with script imbalance and high handwriting variability; non-LLM benchmark.
